speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing intense itching and developing red bumps on your thigh and other parts of your body. To help me determine the cause, have you recently traveled to an area with mosquito or tick populations, or are you taking any new medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. speaker: Doctor
